summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Applied Finance IVS International Large ETF (IVSI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF focusing on long-term capital appreciation by investing in large-cap stocks in developed international markets. The fund uses proprietary fundamental analysis to select holdings. IVSI was launched on Dec 11, 2025 and is issued by Applied Finance.

holdings.infoBox: IVSI is an equity ETF with a total of 207 individual holdings. The top holdings are ASML Holding stock at 5.17%, Roche Holding AG at 3.49%, BHP Group at 3.24%, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group at 2.41%, and Novartis AG at 2.30%.
